records.title: Noetic Topos measures cognition, alignment, or safety
records.claim_text: The formal Noetic Topos construction is an empirically validated measurement of cognition, alignment, or safety.
records.falsifier: The formal source explicitly defers empirical validation; a negative preregistered validation or larger matched-control effect would falsify a future scoped claim.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying empirical estimate is attached to this record.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: A formal topos-existence theorem cannot license this empirical claim.

records.title: Projector profiles establish latent cognitive capacity
records.claim_text: Learned projector-valued profiles identify CAS/TKS cognitive subspaces and satisfy a capacity bound that predicts held-out model behavior.
records.falsifier: No held-out specificity gain over the mixed-simplex baseline, larger control effects, unstable projectors, or failure to construct the theorem's intertwiner.
records.uncertainty: No qualifying estimate exists; the mathematical capacity transfer has a proof gap.
reviewers: Project Coherence internal mathematical red team
notes: Kernel correctness and empirical representation validity are separate questions.

records.title: CAS-Ohm scores are physical electrical measurements
records.claim_text: CAS-Ohm design scores, behavioral proxies, or model-derived quantities are physical electrical telemetry or validated measurements.
records.falsifier: Absence of an instrumented field, failure of calibration/linearity, or disagreement with known-fault measurements.
records.uncertainty: Current source boundaries classify uninstrumented quantities as design values, proxies, or scores rather than telemetry.
notes: Zero instrumented fields remain calibration exercises and are excluded from Evidence Packets.

records.title: Historical Harness v1.6 establishes current production readiness
records.claim_text: The CAS Harness v1.6 reconciled spec sheet is sufficient current evidence of production readiness or customer efficacy.
records.falsifier: Any current unresolved gate, unavailable provider path, failing acceptance test, stale deployment, or missing claim record defeats the blanket readiness claim.
records.uncertainty: The v1.6 artifact is historical and contains superseded or retracted language; current status must be rechecked.
notes: No research theorem automatically changes the live product-claim record.
